svg.desc: A typical successful data question moves between the browser, app, AI provider, and database. SQL is drafted and checked before read-only execution. The app can explain all loaded rows (up to 1,000) before returning the final answer and table. Direct answers and failures are covered in the assistant and cancellation diagrams.
svg.title: One data question — the journey in time order

g.text: 2. Use the question and table list
